title: Journal and timeline
summary: The record of everything that happens in the garden: entries with photos and notes, automatic entries, timelines, the harvest log, search and export. It is the user-facing view of the activity log and what the roadmap and AI learn from.

features.title: Entries with photos and notes
features.story: As a beginner gardener, I want to log what I did in a zone, bed or planting with photos and notes, so that I have a record the app and AI can learn from.
acceptance: I can create an entry of a given type (watering, feeding, sowing, planting out, weeding, mulching, pruning, treating, harvesting, observation, problem)
An entry is linked to a zone, a bed or a planting
I can attach one or more photos and a free-text note
Every entry is stored as an activity log event and never overwritten
Entries appear immediately in the journal list

tasks.title: Define journal entry types and payload schema
tasks.description: Define the journal entry types and their payload fields as activity log event types. Done when the schema is documented and versioned.

tasks.title: Add journal entry events to the activity log model
tasks.description: Add EF Core mapping and migration for journal entry events (type, target zone/bed/planting, note, photo refs, occurred-at). Done when migration applies cleanly.

tasks.title: Create journal entry API endpoint
tasks.description: POST endpoint that validates the entry and appends it to the activity log. Done when OpenAPI is updated and the endpoint returns the created entry.

tasks.title: List journal entries API with paging
tasks.description: GET endpoint returning entries for the user, newest first, with paging and target filter. Done when paging works with 200+ entries.

tasks.title: Backend tests for journal entries
tasks.description: Unit and integration tests for create/list, validation and user scoping. Done when tests pass in CI.

tasks.title: Design journal entry form
tasks.description: Sketch the entry form: type picker, target picker, note, photos. Done when the layout is agreed and saved in docs.

tasks.title: Build journal entry form on iOS
tasks.description: SwiftUI form with type, target (zone/bed/planting), note and photo picker/camera. Done when an entry can be saved through the generated API client.

tasks.title: Attach photos to entries on iOS
tasks.description: Upload photos through the media service (SAS URLs) and link them to the entry. Done when photos show on the saved entry.

tasks.title: Build journal list screen on iOS
tasks.description: List of entries with type icon, target, date, note preview and photo thumbnail. Done when it scrolls smoothly with paging.

tasks.title: Test journal entries on iPhone
tasks.description: Create entries of each type with photos at the plot. Done when entries, photos and list behave correctly.

features.title: Quick and bulk logging
features.story: As a gardener in the field, I want to log common actions in one tap and for several beds at once, so that logging is fast.
acceptance: One-tap logging for common actions
Logging the same action for several beds at once

features.title: Voice notes
features.story: As a gardener with dirty hands, I want to dictate notes, so that I don't have to type in the field.
acceptance: Dictation uses on-device speech recognition
Works offline

features.title: Automatic entries
features.story: As a gardener, I want completed roadmap actions, tasks and guide steps to be logged automatically, so that I don't log things twice.
acceptance: Completing a task creates a journal entry linked to the task
Completing a roadmap action creates a journal entry
Completing a guide step creates a journal entry
Automatic entries are marked as automatic and can have notes or photos added later

tasks.title: Map task, roadmap and guide completion events to journal entries
tasks.description: Define how completion events from tasks, roadmap actions and guide steps appear as journal entries. Done when the mapping is documented.

tasks.title: Generate journal entries from completion events
tasks.description: Handler that creates a linked journal entry when a completion event is appended. Done when each source creates exactly one entry.

tasks.title: Allow adding notes and photos to automatic entries
tasks.description: Append-only annotation event that adds a note or photo to an existing entry. Done when the annotation shows with the entry.

tasks.title: Tests for automatic entries
tasks.description: Tests that each completion source creates one entry and no duplicates on retries. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Show automatic entries in the iOS journal
tasks.description: Distinct marker for automatic entries, link back to the task/action/guide, and 'add note or photo' action. Done when visible and tappable.

tasks.title: Test automatic entries on iPhone
tasks.description: Complete a task, an action and a guide step and check the journal. Done when all three appear correctly.

features.title: Weather on each day
features.story: As a gardener, I want each day in the journal to show its rain and temperatures, so that I can relate what happened to the weather.
acceptance: Each journal day shows min/max temperature and rainfall
Weather comes from the stored weather history for the plot
Past days show recorded weather, not forecast

tasks.title: Store daily observed weather per plot
tasks.description: Daily job saves observed min/max temperature and rainfall per plot from the weather data service. Done when 30 days of history accumulate correctly.

tasks.title: Expose daily weather in the journal API
tasks.description: Add daily weather to journal day groups in the list API. Done when OpenAPI shows it.

tasks.title: Show weather on journal day headers on iOS
tasks.description: Compact weather chip (temps, rain) on each journal day header. Done when shown for each day with data.

tasks.title: Test weather on journal days
tasks.description: Compare shown values with the weather source for a few days. Done when values match.

features.title: Change the date
features.story: As a gardener, I want to log something after the fact with the real date, so that the history is accurate.
acceptance: I can choose a past date and time when creating an entry
Backdated entries sort by their real date
The record keeps both the occurred-at and recorded-at times

tasks.title: Support occurred-at separate from recorded-at
tasks.description: Validate a past occurred-at date (not in the future) while keeping the recorded-at timestamp. Done when both are stored and sorted correctly.

tasks.title: Add date and time picker to the iOS entry form
tasks.description: Default to now with an option to pick a past date. Done when backdated entries appear in the right place.

tasks.title: Test backdated entries
tasks.description: Log an entry for yesterday and last week. Done when ordering and roadmap recalculation are correct.

features.title: Timeline views
features.story: As a gardener, I want to see the history of a zone, a bed or a planting, so that I can understand what has happened to it.
acceptance: Timeline for a zone, a bed or a planting, newest first
Shows entries with photos and notes
Reachable from the zone, bed and planting screens

tasks.title: Timeline API filtered by zone, bed or planting
tasks.description: Endpoint returning entries for one target including child beds/plantings of a zone. Done when filters return correct sets.

tasks.title: Timeline API tests
tasks.description: Tests for target filtering and user scoping. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Build timeline screen on iOS
tasks.description: Vertical timeline with date groups, entry cards and photos. Done when it renders a zone, a bed and a planting.

tasks.title: Link timeline from zone, bed and planting screens
tasks.description: Add 'History' entry points. Done when each opens the right timeline.

tasks.title: Test timelines on iPhone
tasks.description: Check timelines for a zone, bed and planting with real entries. Done when contents are correct.

features.title: Photo time-lapse
features.story: As a gardener, I want a time-lapse from my fixed photo spots, so that I can see progress over time.
acceptance: Photos from the same fixed spot play in date order

features.title: Harvest log
features.story: As a gardener, I want to record what I harvest by weight or count, so that I can see yields and compare them with what was expected.
acceptance: I can log a harvest with crop, variety, planting, weight or count
Season totals per crop and variety are shown
Each harvest is compared with the expected yield where known
Harvest entries are activity log events

tasks.title: Add harvest entry type with quantity and unit
tasks.description: Harvest event payload: planting, crop, variety, quantity, unit (kg, g, count). Done when stored and validated.

tasks.title: Season totals and expected-yield comparison API
tasks.description: Aggregate harvests per crop/variety per season and compare with expected yield from the crop catalog and plant count. Done when totals are correct for test data.

tasks.title: Harvest log tests
tasks.description: Tests for aggregation, units and seasons. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Build harvest entry form on iOS
tasks.description: Quick form with planting picker, quantity and unit. Done when a harvest is saved.

tasks.title: Build harvest summary screen on iOS
tasks.description: Season totals per crop with expected vs actual bars. Done when it shows real data.

tasks.title: Test the harvest log on iPhone
tasks.description: Log several harvests and check totals. Done when numbers match.

features.title: Harvest value
features.story: As a gardener, I want an estimated value of my harvest using prices I enter, so that I can see if the garden pays off.
acceptance: User-entered prices per crop
Estimated value per season

features.title: Search and filters
features.story: As a gardener, I want to search and filter my journal, so that I can find things like every time I treated the tomatoes.
acceptance: Free-text search over notes
Filter by entry type, zone/bed/planting, crop and date range
Filters can be combined

tasks.title: Add full-text search index for journal notes
tasks.description: PostgreSQL full-text index (PT and EN) on entry notes. Done when queries use the index.

tasks.title: Journal search and filter API
tasks.description: Query parameters for text, type, target, crop and date range. Done when combinations return correct results.

tasks.title: Search and filter tests
tasks.description: Tests for each filter and combinations. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Build search bar and filter sheet on iOS
tasks.description: Search field plus filter sheet with chips. Done when filtering updates the list.

tasks.title: Test journal search on iPhone
tasks.description: Search for real entries in PT and EN. Done when results are as expected.

features.title: Export CSV/PDF
features.story: As a gardener, I want to export my journal to CSV or PDF, so that I can keep or share a copy.
acceptance: Export the journal or a filtered view to CSV
Export to PDF with photos as thumbnails
The file can be shared from the iPhone share sheet

tasks.title: CSV export endpoint
tasks.description: Stream journal entries (respecting filters) as CSV. Done when the file opens correctly in Numbers.

tasks.title: PDF export endpoint
tasks.description: Generate a PDF with entries and photo thumbnails. Done when a 50-entry export renders correctly.

tasks.title: Export tests
tasks.description: Tests for CSV columns, filters and PDF generation. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Export action and share sheet on iOS
tasks.description: Export button with format choice, then the iOS share sheet. Done when the file can be saved to Files.

tasks.title: Test exports on iPhone
tasks.description: Export CSV and PDF and open them. Done when contents are correct.

title: Tasks and reminders
summary: The garden to-do list: tasks from every source with date ranges, estimates and outcomes, Today/Week/zone views, a weekend planner, weather-aware rescheduling, missed-task alternatives, reminders, a morning summary and sharing with helpers.

features.title: Tasks from all sources
features.story: As a gardener, I want tasks to come from the roadmap, calendar, regular care, weather, AI and myself, so that I have one to-do list for the garden.
acceptance: Tasks can be created manually
Accepted roadmap next actions become tasks
Calendar and regular care create tasks
Weather alerts and confirmed AI proposals create tasks
Each task records its source

tasks.title: Task data model and migration
tasks.description: Task entity: title, target, date range, estimate, priority, guide link, tools, source, status, version for sync. Done when migration applies.

tasks.title: Task CRUD API
tasks.description: Create, read, update and delete endpoints with validation and user scoping. Done when OpenAPI is updated.

tasks.title: Task source tracking and links
tasks.description: Store source type and source id (roadmap action, calendar window, care rule, alert, proposal, manual). Done when tasks link back to their source.

tasks.title: Create tasks from accepted roadmap actions
tasks.description: Accepting a next action creates a task with its window, estimate and guide. Done when accepted actions appear as tasks.

tasks.title: Create tasks from calendar windows and care rules
tasks.description: Generate tasks for sowing/planting windows of chosen crops and regular care. Done when generation is idempotent.

tasks.title: Task generation tests
tasks.description: Tests for each source and duplicate prevention. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Build manual task creation on iOS
tasks.description: Form to add a task with target, date range and notes. Done when a manual task is saved.

tasks.title: Show task source on iOS
tasks.description: Source badge and link to the originating item. Done when tapping opens the source.

tasks.title: Test task sources on iPhone
tasks.description: Create tasks from each available source. Done when all appear correctly.

features.title: Task details
features.story: As a gardener, I want each task to show its date range, time estimate, priority and guide, so that I know when and how to do it.
acceptance: Tasks have a date range rather than a single day
Each task shows estimated time and priority
Each task links to its guide
Task detail shows target zone, bed or planting

tasks.title: Date range, estimate and priority fields with validation
tasks.description: Validate start ≤ end, estimate in minutes, priority levels. Done when invalid input is rejected.

tasks.title: Design task detail screen
tasks.description: Layout for date range, estimate, priority, guide link, tools and target. Done when agreed.

tasks.title: Build task detail screen on iOS
tasks.description: Detail view with editing of date range, estimate and priority, and guide link. Done when edits save.

tasks.title: Test task details on iPhone
tasks.description: Edit tasks and open guides from tasks. Done when everything works.

features.title: Tools check
features.story: As a gardener, I want a task to warn me if I'm missing a tool it needs, so that I can get it in time.
acceptance: Tasks list the tools they need
Missing tools are highlighted
Missing tools link to the 'tools to get' list

tasks.title: Compute missing tools per task
tasks.description: Compare task tools with the user's owned tools. Done when the API returns missing tools per task.

tasks.title: Show tools and missing-tool warning on iOS
tasks.description: Tool list on the task with a warning and a link to 'tools to get'. Done when shown correctly.

tasks.title: Test the tools check
tasks.description: Remove an owned tool and check the warning. Done when the warning appears.

features.title: Task outcomes
features.story: As a gardener, I want to mark a task as done, skipped or couldn't do (with a reason), so that the roadmap adapts to what really happened.
acceptance: Tasks can be marked done, skipped or couldn't do
Skipped and couldn't do require or allow a reason
Each outcome is appended to the activity log
The roadmap recalculates after an outcome

tasks.title: Task outcome events in the activity log
tasks.description: Append done/skipped/couldn't-do events with reason and timestamp. Done when the task status reflects the latest outcome.

tasks.title: Trigger roadmap recalculation on outcomes
tasks.description: Publish an event so the roadmap engine recalculates the zone. Done when next actions update after an outcome.

tasks.title: Outcome tests
tasks.description: Tests for each outcome and recalculation trigger. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Outcome actions and reason sheet on iOS
tasks.description: Swipe actions and buttons for done/skip/couldn't do, with a reason sheet. Done when outcomes save.

tasks.title: Test task outcomes on iPhone
tasks.description: Mark tasks with each outcome and check the roadmap. Done when behaviour is correct.

features.title: Today, Week and zone views
features.story: As a gardener, I want to see tasks for today, this week, and by zone, so that I can focus on what matters now.
acceptance: Today view shows tasks whose window includes today, by priority
Week view groups tasks by day
Zone view groups tasks by zone and bed
Overdue tasks are highlighted

tasks.title: Task query API for today, week and zone
tasks.description: Endpoints or filters returning tasks for a date window and grouped by zone. Done when results are correct across time zones.

tasks.title: Task query tests
tasks.description: Tests for date windows, time zones and grouping. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Build Today and Week task lists on iOS
tasks.description: Segmented lists with priority sorting and overdue highlighting. Done when both views work.

tasks.title: Build zone task view on iOS
tasks.description: Tasks grouped by zone and bed. Done when it matches the plot structure.

tasks.title: Test task views on iPhone
tasks.description: Check views over a week of real tasks. Done when grouping and sorting are right.

features.title: Weekend planner
features.story: As a weekend gardener, I want to enter the hours I have and get the most important tasks that fit, so that I use my time well.
acceptance: I can enter available hours for a day or weekend
The app proposes tasks that fit, by priority and window urgency
I can accept the plan, which schedules the tasks
The plan respects tasks that must happen before others

tasks.title: Weekend planning algorithm
tasks.description: Select tasks by priority, window urgency and estimate to fit available hours (knapsack-style), respecting order dependencies. Done when it produces sensible plans for test data.

tasks.title: Weekend planner API
tasks.description: Endpoint taking available hours and dates, returning the proposed plan. Done when OpenAPI is updated.

tasks.title: Weekend planner tests
tasks.description: Tests for fitting, priorities and dependencies. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Build weekend planner screen on iOS
tasks.description: Hours input, proposed plan with total time, accept action. Done when an accepted plan schedules the tasks.

tasks.title: Test the weekend planner on a real weekend
tasks.description: Use it for a real weekend at the plot. Done when the plan was realistic or adjustments are noted.

features.title: Weather-aware rescheduling
features.story: As a gardener, I want tasks rescheduled automatically for the weather, so that I don't water before rain or spray in the wind.
acceptance: Watering tasks are skipped or moved when rain is forecast
In a heatwave, watering is moved to early morning
Spraying is postponed when wind is forecast
Each change is explained on the task and logged

tasks.title: Define weather rescheduling rules
tasks.description: Rules for rain, heat and wind per task type, with thresholds. Done when documented with test cases.

tasks.title: Daily rescheduling job
tasks.description: Job applies rules to upcoming tasks using the forecast and records the change and reason. Done when changes are applied once per forecast change.

tasks.title: Rescheduling tests
tasks.description: Tests for each rule and idempotency. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Show rescheduling reason on iOS
tasks.description: Banner on the task explaining the change, with an undo option. Done when visible and undo works.

tasks.title: Test rescheduling with real forecasts
tasks.description: Watch it over a rainy and a hot period. Done when changes are sensible.

features.title: Repeating tasks
features.story: As a gardener, I want repeating tasks such as weekly feeding, so that I don't recreate them.
acceptance: Tasks can repeat on a schedule

features.title: Missed-task alternatives
features.story: As a gardener, I want an alternative when I miss a time-sensitive task, so that I'm not left with a useless overdue task.
acceptance: Time-sensitive tasks are flagged when their window closes
The roadmap engine suggests an alternative (e.g. a later variety, a different method)
I can accept the alternative or dismiss the task

tasks.title: Detect missed time-sensitive tasks
tasks.description: Daily job marks tasks whose window closed without an outcome. Done when missed tasks are flagged.

tasks.title: Request alternatives from the roadmap engine
tasks.description: Rules layer proposes an alternative action for the missed one. Done when common cases (sowing window missed) get an alternative.

tasks.title: Missed-task tests
tasks.description: Tests for detection and alternatives. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Missed-task card with alternative on iOS
tasks.description: Card showing the missed task and the alternative, with accept or dismiss. Done when accepting creates the new task.

tasks.title: Test missed-task alternatives
tasks.description: Let a sowing window pass on a test task. Done when the alternative is sensible.

features.title: On-phone reminders
features.story: As a gardener, I want reminders scheduled on the phone, so that I'm reminded even without a connection.
acceptance: Tasks can have a reminder time
Reminders are scheduled as local notifications
Reminders update when tasks change or complete

tasks.title: Reminder field on tasks
tasks.description: Optional reminder time on tasks, synced to the app. Done when stored and returned.

tasks.title: Schedule local notifications on iOS
tasks.description: Use UNUserNotificationCenter to schedule, update and cancel reminders. Done when reminders fire offline.

tasks.title: Notification permission flow on iOS
tasks.description: Ask for permission at a sensible moment with an explanation. Done when denial is handled.

tasks.title: Test reminders on iPhone
tasks.description: Set reminders and go offline. Done when they fire on time.

features.title: Morning summary
features.story: As a gardener, I want one daily morning summary instead of many notifications, so that I'm informed without noise.
acceptance: One push notification per morning at my chosen time
Summarises today's tasks, alerts and pending proposals
Tapping opens the Today screen

tasks.title: Morning summary job per user time zone
tasks.description: Scheduled job builds a summary per user at their chosen time and sends it through push infrastructure. Done when each user gets one per day.

tasks.title: Morning summary tests
tasks.description: Tests for time zones and content. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Summary time setting and deep link on iOS
tasks.description: Setting for the summary time and deep link to Today. Done when tapping opens Today.

tasks.title: Test the morning summary for a week
tasks.description: Check daily delivery and content. Done when reliable.

features.title: Quiet hours
features.story: As a user, I want quiet hours, so that I'm not disturbed at night.
acceptance: No non-urgent notifications during quiet hours

features.title: Share tasks with family
features.story: As a gardener, I want to share tasks with family or helpers, so that they can see and do them.
acceptance: I can invite a helper to my garden
Helpers see and can complete shared tasks
Outcomes show who did the task
I can remove a helper

tasks.title: Design garden sharing and helper roles
tasks.description: Decide roles (owner, helper), what helpers can see and do, and the invite flow. Done when documented.

tasks.title: Garden membership model and migration
tasks.description: Membership entity with roles; update data scoping so helpers access shared gardens. Done when scoping tests pass.

tasks.title: Invite and accept API
tasks.description: Create invite links, accept, and remove members. Done when the flow works end to end.

tasks.title: Record who completed a task
tasks.description: Store the actor on outcome events. Done when shown in task history.

tasks.title: Sharing and permission tests
tasks.description: Tests that helpers only access shared data. Done when tests pass.

tasks.title: Invite and member management on iOS
tasks.description: Invite sheet, member list and remove action. Done when a helper can join.

tasks.title: Show task completer on iOS
tasks.description: Display who did each task. Done when visible.

tasks.title: Test sharing with a second account
tasks.description: Invite a second account and complete tasks. Done when access and attribution are correct.

title: Tools

features.title: My tools with reference images

acceptance: Every catalog tool has a reference image
Images appear in my tools, tasks, guides, 'tools to get' and the starter toolkit
Images are reviewed before publishing

tasks.title: Add images to the tool catalog pipeline

tasks.title: Show tool images across iOS screens
tasks.description: Display images in my tools, tasks, guides and lists with caching. Done when images appear everywhere tools are shown.

tasks.title: Test tool images on iPhone
tasks.description: Check images are correct and recognisable. Done when all reviewed.

features.title: Own photo of a tool
features.story: As a gardener, I want to replace a tool's image with a photo of my own tool, so that it's easy to find.
acceptance: I can take or pick a photo for an owned tool
My photo replaces the catalog image for that tool
I can revert to the catalog image

features.title: Tools needed per action

acceptance: A tool catalog exists (name, purpose, PT/EN)
I can add and remove tools I own
Roadmap actions, tasks and guides list required tools
Missing tools are flagged

Marking a tool as got adds it to my tools

tasks.description: List with need dates, linked tasks, choice and 'got it'. Done when working end to end.

The buy/rent/borrow information is still kept

tasks.title: Test buy/rent/borrow advice

acceptance: Maintenance rules per tool (sharpen, clean, store before frost)
Reminders become tasks
Seasonal reminders follow the local climate

features.title: Shop links and affiliates
features.story: As a gardener, I want links to buy missing tools, so that getting them is easy (and could generate revenue later).
acceptance: Tools to get can show shop links
Links are configurable per country
Affiliate tags can be added without code changes

tasks.title: Research shop and affiliate options for Portugal
tasks.description: Identify shops and affiliate programmes and their terms. Done when a short recommendation is documented.

tasks.title: Shop link model per tool and country
tasks.description: Store links per tool and country with optional affiliate tag. Done when the API returns links.

tasks.title: Show shop links on iOS
tasks.description: 'Buy' button opening the link in Safari. Done when working.

tasks.title: Test shop links
tasks.description: Open links for a few tools. Done when correct.
